semantic.justification: Native optional fragment failure, basename lowercase retry, relation caching and strict/transitional root resolution; part-local/global relation ID counters and IURI conversion. Ports only the consumed XML/package contract; native UNO services, general storage hierarchy, encrypted/ZIP64 packages, XLSB RecordParser and complete application document filters are outside this prerequisite. Strings/byte arrays and Promises bind host XML/ZIP transport; whole-module parity remains unverified.
